objects.summary: Stage-A capture completes and is independently verified: 21088/21088 compressed archives, zero missing, zero parsed rows. Stage-B compressed collection runs separately. Stage-A runner refuses calculation while prior private result exposure remains UNKNOWN; atomic look reservation and provenance are prepared.

After remote search finds no accessible prior result/reservation, Codex proceeds under UNKNOWN lineage: one atomic discovery look may be executed, uncertainty is written into metadata, no confirmatory claim is allowed, and any later-found prior exposure must be preserved.

First documented F1 Stage-A result: theta=20%, annualized mean 3.823%, Sharpe 0.490, robust t 0.957, double-cost 1.114%, CAGR 3.592%, max DD 7.061%, exposure 52.09%. Mean is below assumed 4% cash. Status INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED; no retuning and Stage B remains sealed.

Autonomous Stage-B controller authenticates A and waits existing B capture; it will verify full coverage, atomically claim one B look, persist result/meta/report and publish verdict even without active agent. F2 remains BLOCKED_DATA_PERMISSION.

B publication path is CI-qualified and fixture-tested for duplicate/mismatched publication. Old controller is safely replaced while capture remains active; no B reservation/calculation has occurred yet. Other swarm families remain killed/blocked by data, host or provenance constraints.

Stage-B acquisition attempt 1 times out after 300 minutes at 33100/35789 archives, but partial compressed artifact persists. Controller aborts before verification/look claim/economic run. Attempt 2 resumes same plan and missing keys only; no look/power reset and no duplicate acquisition.

cross_object_findings.finding: After extensive infrastructure/governance work, F1 Stage A finally produces bounded economic evidence: positive raw mean but weak t-stat, below assumed cash and underpowered. Correct status is INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED, not edge proof or family kill.

Inaccessible private-history uncertainty is persisted rather than erased; one discovery result is allowed with confirmatory claims disabled and any recovered prior exposure required to remain in lineage.
Stage-B controller can wait for an existing capture, verify it, atomically claim the look, execute once, persist results and publish a verdict without requiring a live Claude/Codex session.
A 300-minute acquisition timeout does not destroy 33100 downloaded archives; partial artifact and plan identity allow same-run recovery while preserving unopened economic look.
Partial archive counts and successful recovery are kept distinct from statistical/economic evidence; no B statistic is inferred before complete coverage and atomic look reservation.
